notes.title: New Trailer and Release Date
notes.content:
[h1][u]Double news:[/u][/h1]

[b]New Trailer[/b]. It's now available on our Steam Store Page.

While the original trailer was kept brief and flashy, this one takes its time to show everything you can find in the game: the 4 playable ships, the different mission types, environments and unlockables. We used all in-game music so you could get a taste of that too.

It is intended for anyone that was interested in the mechanics but wasn't sure about the game's depth. Hopefully this trailer will clear all doubts in that regard.


[b]Release Date[/b]. Finally, we have our [b]final[/b] launch date! And it's a pretty date too:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38752181/58016a317c94e2d6cf214b3dc3ee9bd184ff4ec6.jpg[/img]



We're very happy to conclude our first project, and excited to continue providing support and updates after launch. We truly hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With the launch date closing in, I'll be posting the fixes and implementations for each game update. The pre-launch fixes apply to both the demo and the beta build (to whoever has access to it).


[u]Here are the patch notes of version 0.1.5:[/u]

- Implemented Modern Controls (WASD + mouse or Left + Right Analogs).
- Gamepads/controllers full support.
- Beautified all Destroy Enemies missions backgrounds.
- Implemented final Achievement Section.
- Added visual feedback for trap doors.
- Bug fixing: Power Ups, Map Icons, Enemies, Tutorial Texts, Map Controller sensitivity with controllers, Return from map released carried item with controllers.

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We hope you enjoy the Gravitators Demo. This is a summary of what's included:

[list]
[*] 12 missions (4 of which are interactive tutorials for each Gravitator ship, for you to learn the controls).
[*] 2 Gravitator ships are unlocked from the start, the other 2 are unlocked as you play.
[*] The demo follows the same progression as the full game, so any progress you achieve on the demo will be saved for the full game. This way, you can pick up where you left off.
[*] You can replay normal (non tutorial) missions with any unlocked ships.
[*] Awards, power ups and perks can also be unlocked normally.
[/list]

If you have any issues or need any help, you can contact us through any of our channels. The game is currently in development, so while we've polished as much as we could, a bug or two might have slipped through.

Thanks for taking the time to play our game! If you enjoyed it, don't forget to wishlist it so you get notified on release date.
